title: Cooler Tools
description: Cooler Tools adds knives that are faster than swords and provide extra meat when butchering animals. Also includes obsidian and windcharged tools and useful new enchantments like AutoSmelt.
body:
# Cooler Tools

Cooler Tools is a lightweight Vanilla+ mod designed to improve your everyday Minecraft experience without breaking the game's balance. It focuses on adding useful tools and unique mechanics that save time and make survival more rewarding.

---

## Key Features

* **Knives:** Faster than swords but with slightly less damage. Their main power is Butchery — kill animals with a knife to get bonus meat drops! Supports all vanilla materials from wood to netherite.
* **Obsidian Tools:** A new tier of equipment. Tougher and more durable than Diamond, perfect for those who aren't ready for the Netherite grind yet.
* **Windcharged Gear:** Special tools with unique aesthetics and great stats to power up your late-game experience.

---

## New Enchantments

* **AutoSmelt:** Efficiency at its finest! Automatically melts ores while you mine them, saving you coal and time.
* **Boom:** High-risk, high-reward. This enchantment explodes the block you just mined, allowing for rapid excavation of large areas.
* **Poisoning:** A combat-focused enchantment that applies a poison effect to your enemies, making your weapons even more deadly.

---

## Why Cooler Tools?

Unlike big overhaul mods, Cooler Tools stays true to the vanilla feel. No complex machines or confusing mechanics — just grab your gear and play!
